g.text: Half of Punjab's urban earners make Rs 240,000 a year or less; the top tenth make Rs 660,000 or more
Source: PSLM 2019-20. Sample: earners aged 15-64, Punjab urban (n = 3768). Weighted by hhweight. 25 earners outside Rs 10,000-Rs 10,000,000 excluded.
